'''R4-F5''' was a [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that helped [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] operate [[Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|his Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], bearing the [[Color/Legends|colors]] as the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]&mdash;blue and white.

In 19 BBY, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jai'galaar (clone)|Jag]] received a coded transmission from [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] ordering him to execute [[Order 66/Legends|clone protocol 66]] and kill his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|commander]], Koon. He and his squad of [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] subsequently fired upon Plo's [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] the ill-prepared [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. R4-F5 was destroyed when the badly damaged starfighter collided with a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] staging area on a [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidian]] [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge city]].

==Behind the scenes==
This astromech droid was partly made into an action figure, built into [[Hasbro]]'s toy model of Koon's Delta-7. Later, in 2008, Hasbro also made R4-F5 into a full figure as part of the Droid Factory exclusive for Wal-Mart.

Delta-7 ''Aethersprite'' fighters usually do not feature a [[Astromech socket/Legends|droid socket]], so R4-F5 would have to have been modified as [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]] was for [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]].
